title: Chile · Carretera Austral Northern Stage
slogan: A 529 km loop out of Hornopirén ferry
story: Remote Patagonia, ferries and a route that demands planning. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 212 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Pumalín forest, Futaleufú river roads, while Hornopirén ferry gate and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Carretera Austral
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 37 km this is Carretera Austral, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
